responsibility: Declares the public helper interface for tree induction-variable optimization code. It exposes utilities to inspect and dump IVs, IV uses, and candidates, test abnormal SSA participation and loop invariance of expressions, strip offsets, query the single dominating exit, drive the ivopts pass, and create canonical IVs for loops with known iteration counts.
same_name_distinction: Declares the external ivopts interface—dump helpers, IV/query utilities, single_dom_exit, canonical-IV creation, and the tree_ssa_iv_optimize entry point. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-loop-ivopts.cc, it does not contain the optimization algorithm or cost/rewrite implementation.
